claim_scope: Engineering/runtime parity and latency for one fixed-charge methyl-hexanoate topology and three fixed coordinate arrays. This does not establish hydration accuracy, relative-ranking accuracy, force support, optimization/sampling support, universal latency, or a new default Route-1 endpoint.

source.charge_source: frozen AM1-BCC charge column in the pinned MOL2

comparison.legacy_reference: For every coordinate array, render typed MOL2 plus fixed charges, run parmchk2 and tleap, then run GBNSR6 and PBSA.
comparison.prepared_provider: Prepare typed MOL2, frcmod, and prmtop once in the provider instance; every coordinate array writes only Amber inpcrd before GBNSR6 and PBSA.

prohibited_interpretations: No experimental hydration value is read, fit, or used as a target.
No gas-phase MM or bonded MM energy is added.
No prediction energy is linearly calibrated or residual-corrected.
No force, geometry optimization, scan, sampling, protein-ligand, or universal-throughput claim is made.
